offers.name: Storage Expansion Bag (x5)

capture.note: The source line reads ‘Storage Expansion Bag (x5) ×5’; the catalog preserves the package label without multiplying it again.

offers.bestFor: Players who have confirmed they need shared-storage expansion.
offers.skipIf: Your storage is already sufficient or the package semantics are unclear to you.
caveats: Confirm the in-game tooltip before purchase because the poster repeats x5 in both the title and item line.

offers.name: General Inventory Bag (x6)

capture.note: Quantity and price visually verified.

offers.bestFor: Characters that still need general inventory slots.
offers.skipIf: The intended character is already expanded.
caveats: Inventory expansion is character-specific; confirm the receiving character.

offers.name: Memorial Package Bundle X

capture.note: Both component quantities visually verified.

offers.bestFor: Players actively rerolling Memorial pieces.
offers.skipIf: You do not have a near-term Memorial reroll target.
caveats: The Reset Crystal value is a medium-confidence maintainer estimate dated 2026-08-05.

offers.name: Super Dawn Hammer Coupon (x20)

capture.note: Quantity and price visually verified.

offers.bestFor: Players enchanting Dawn gear in the hammer's supported range.
offers.skipIf: You have no compatible Dawn upgrade planned.
caveats: Confirm the hammer's supported enchant levels in-game.

offers.name: Noble Dawn Hammer (x20)

capture.note: Quantity and price visually verified.

offers.bestFor: Players accepting RNG on high-level Dawn enchants.
offers.skipIf: You do not need high-level Dawn attempts.
caveats: Cost effectiveness depends on success probability and your remaining target levels.

offers.name: Instance Dungeon Guaranteed Titlebook Coupon II

capture.note: Variant II visually verified.

offers.bestFor: Title collectors missing an eligible dungeon title.
offers.skipIf: You already own the useful titles in this coupon.
caveats: Ownership and the coupon's eligible title pool determine personal value.

offers.name: La Tale Adventure Dice Package (x500)

capture.note: Quantity and price visually verified.

offers.bestFor: Players who will use the full dice stack in Adventure progression.
offers.skipIf: You already hold more dice than you expect to use.
caveats: The maintained unit value is a market observation dated 2026-08-03.

offers.name: Royal Skill: Guaranteed Titlebook Coupon

capture.note: Name, price, and limit visually verified.

offers.bestFor: Players missing a useful title from the eligible pool.
offers.skipIf: The available titles duplicate your collection.
caveats: Personal value depends on the eligible title pool and ownership.

offers.name: Giga Mysterious Fragment (x2000)

capture.note: Quantity and price visually verified.

offers.bestFor: Players accelerating Relic progression.
offers.skipIf: Relic points are not a current bottleneck.
caveats: Compare against your farm rate before assigning an Ely equivalent.

offers.name: Giga Platinum Hammer (x100)

capture.note: Poster title says Giga; item line says Platinum Hammer ×100.

offers.bestFor: Players with a planned high-volume enchant session.
offers.skipIf: You cannot use most of the 100 hammers soon.
caveats: Unused inventory lowers personal utility even when the unit price is attractive.

offers.name: Tip Costume Set Box

capture.note: Name, price, and limit visually verified.

offers.bestFor: Players who personally want this costume.
offers.skipIf: The appearance is not worth 1,590 LTC to you.
caveats: Cosmetic offers intentionally have no default Ely value.

offers.name: Tipeta Costume Set Box

capture.note: Name, price, and limit visually verified.

offers.bestFor: Players who personally want this costume.
offers.skipIf: The appearance is not worth 1,590 LTC to you.
caveats: Cosmetic offers intentionally have no default Ely value.

offers.name: Goddess' Card of Eternity Coupon

capture.note: Name, price, and limit visually verified.

offers.bestFor: Endgame players who still benefit from the permanent card upgrade.
offers.skipIf: You already have the relevant card progression covered.
caveats: The 14B Ely value is a medium-confidence maintainer estimate; usefulness remains ownership-dependent.

offers.name: GOLDEN Damage Skin Coupon

capture.note: Name, price, and limit visually verified.

offers.bestFor: Players who personally want the damage-skin appearance.
offers.skipIf: You prefer your current damage skin.
caveats: Cosmetic offers intentionally have no default Ely value.

offers.name: [Event] Gentle Sway Emoticon Tome

capture.note: Name, price, and limit visually verified.

offers.bestFor: Emote collectors who will use this animation.
offers.skipIf: You do not value account cosmetics.
caveats: Cosmetic offers intentionally have no default Ely value.

offers.name: [Event] Pre-kyu Emoticon Tome

capture.note: Name, price, and limit visually verified.

offers.bestFor: Emote collectors who will use this animation.
offers.skipIf: You do not value account cosmetics.
caveats: Cosmetic offers intentionally have no default Ely value.

offers.name: Power Picnic Pack

capture.note: All three component quantities visually verified.

offers.bestFor: Active players able to use the timed buffs immediately.
offers.skipIf: You will be inactive during most of the buff duration.
caveats: Timed-item value depends heavily on utilization.
Picnic Energy is intentionally personal/non-comparable, so only the other components contribute to the objective lower bound.

offers.name: Weekly Grinder's Package III

capture.note: Eight component lines visually verified.

offers.bestFor: Active weekly grinders who will consume the entries and boosts.
offers.skipIf: You cannot use the timed items and entries this week.
caveats: The lower bound excludes Shining Dimensional Rift entries and EXP Nostrum while pending.
Star's Blessing Potion and Eel Energy Extract are personal/non-comparable.

offers.name: Constellation Expansion Package

capture.note: All three component quantities visually verified.

offers.bestFor: Players currently pushing Constellation progression.
offers.skipIf: Constellation points are not a current bottleneck.
caveats: All three component values are medium-confidence maintainer estimates dated 2026-08-05.

offers.name: GM's Guild Bundle 3

capture.note: All five component quantities visually verified.

offers.bestFor: Guild-focused players who can use every progression component.
offers.skipIf: Your guild progression does not need these materials.
caveats: All five components are intentionally personal/non-comparable, so the bundle has no default objective Ely value.

offers.name: Instance Dungeon Guaranteed Titlebook Coupon II

capture.note: Repeated R1 offer; values intentionally reuse the same snapshot item.

offers.bestFor: Title collectors missing an eligible dungeon title.
offers.skipIf: You already own the useful titles in this coupon.
caveats: Ownership and the coupon's eligible title pool determine personal value.

offers.name: Seres' 30 Days Adventure Package

capture.note: All three 30-day components visually verified.

offers.bestFor: Active accounts that will use the 30-day benefits immediately.
offers.skipIf: You will not quest or play consistently during the duration.
caveats: Quest Reward effects may not apply to every activity, including some scenario content.
Petite Hoot Hoot is personal/non-comparable, so only the other components contribute to the objective lower bound.

offers.name: Tome of the Ancients [Account] (30 Days) Skillbook

capture.note: Account scope and 30-day duration visually verified.

offers.bestFor: Active accounts able to use the full 30-day buff.
offers.skipIf: A significant part of the duration will go unused.
caveats: Timed-item value depends on utilization.

offers.name: 30 Days of Paragon

capture.note: Both 30-day coupons visually verified.

offers.bestFor: Active players who benefit from both Paragon buffs for the full month.
offers.skipIf: You only need one buff or expect significant downtime.
caveats: Timed-item value depends on utilization.

offers.name: Memorial Package Bundle X

capture.note: Repeated R1 offer visually verified on poster 2.

offers.bestFor: Players actively rerolling Memorial pieces.
offers.skipIf: You do not have a near-term Memorial reroll target.
caveats: The Reset Crystal value is a medium-confidence maintainer estimate dated 2026-08-05.

offers.name: Great Kandy Pop Pet Package

capture.note: All four component quantities were visually verified; the maintainer confirmed on 2026-08-08 that the listed limit follows the sale-wide stock rule.

offers.bestFor: Players who need this permanent pet and its utility items.
offers.skipIf: You already own an equivalent pet or do not need the puzzles.
caveats: Same-type pet passives may not stack; ownership strongly affects value.

offers.name: Constellation Expansion Package

capture.note: Repeated R4 offer visually verified on poster 2.

offers.bestFor: Players currently pushing Constellation progression.
offers.skipIf: Constellation points are not a current bottleneck.
caveats: All three component values are medium-confidence maintainer estimates dated 2026-08-05.

offers.name: Advanced Guild Package

capture.note: All three component quantities visually verified.

offers.bestFor: Guild players who regularly consume all three resource types.
offers.skipIf: Guild supplies accumulate unused on your account.
caveats: Advanced Guild Food Supply Box remains pending; Greater Guild Coin Box is personal/non-comparable.
